craft_notes: Sthāyin: unveiling — the initiation's hinge. Rows: loosed, seen, become. Rejected: explaining away — killed: seeing is the mechanism. Read aloud: unveiling.

lines: Then swift, eye-cloth loosed of him — through grace-descent blessed means —
seeing face to face the present spell of that station, made of that he becomes;
of graced means the spell-presence is plain,
since as if trembling, the beings.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sahasā apāsitanetrabandho 'sau śaktipātānugṛhītakaraṇatvāt saṃnihitamantraṃ tatsthānaṃ sākṣātkāreṇa paśyan tanmayo bhavati anugṛhītakaraṇānāṃ mantrasaṃnidhiḥ pratyakṣaḥ yatas trasyatām iva bhūtānām
